content: {"skill": "async (b) => { const find = (obs, name) => { const re = new RegExp('^\\\\s*-\\\\s*' + name + '.*?\\\\((\\\\d+),(\\\\d+)\\\\)', 'm'); const m = obs.match(re); return m ? {x:+m[1], y:+m[2]} : null; }; const inv = async () => { const o = await b.observe(); const m = o.match(/Inventory: ([^\\n]*)/); return m ? m[1] : ''; }; const count = (s, name) => { const re = new RegExp('(\\\\d+)\\\\s+' + name, 'i'); const m = s.match(re); return m ? +m[1] : 0; }; const pick = async (name) => { for (let i=0;i<8;i++){ const o = await b.observe(); const p = find(o, name); if (!p) return true; const r = await b.walkTo(p.x, p.y, 'adjacent'); if (!r.ok) { await b.wait(200); continue; } await b.faceAndPress(p.x, p.y, 'KeyE'); await b.wait(200); const s = await inv(); if (count(s, name) > 0) return true; } return false; }; const craft = async () => { const o = await b.observe(); const wb = find(o, 'Workbench'); if (!wb) return false; const r = await b.walkTo(wb.x, wb.y, 'adjacent'); if (!r.ok) return false; await b.faceAndPress(wb.x, wb.y, 'KeyC'); await b.wait(300); const o2 = await b.observe(); return /Crown/i.test(o2); }; let s = await inv(); if (count(s,'Wood') < 3) { await pick('Wood'); } s = await inv(); if (count(s,'Stone') < 2) { await pick('Stone'); } s = await inv(); if (count(s,'Wood') < 3 || count(s,'Stone') < 2) { await pick('Wood'); await pick('Stone'); } return await craft(); }", "check": "async (b) => { const o = await b.observe(); const ok = /Crown/i.test(o); return {ok, detail: ok ? 'Crown present' : 'No Crown found'}; }"}
